title: Winning the case, and marijuana found later in his car
summary: Bubbles beat his case with AGVA's help, then discovered Buck had hidden marijuana in his glove compartment.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: However, I beat my side of the case because all of us was in the same thing,

that's what it was. They got me for being with them and my reason for being with them and I got the AGVA to stand for me in the trial they had and everything. I won my case. But later on I found out this guy had stashed stuff in the car. Buck had stashed stuff in my car and I didn't know it and it's a good thing the police didn't go through the car like a fine tooth comb because they would have had to find it because in some of his clothes they found parts of marijuana, you know. But they didn't look in the glove compartment, 'cause in the glove compartment he had a tobacco pouch full of marijuana with tobacca. Now I don't know it's in there, but after the case is over -- see the car now -- a friend of mine I knew that worked with me in "Carmen Jones," he's living in Canada and I happened to take the car, I sent him a note to get a lawyer for my partner because Joe Grady was acting for me, you know. And when I told him to take the car, he kept the car. When I got the car from him that's when I

found the marijuana in the glove compartment. I said, ain't this something. That scared me to death, 'cause I didn't want to say nothin'. Man, I was scared to death and I was going on down the road. But anyway, I beat that one. Thank God.
